INSERT INTO "EscrowRecord"
             ("id","debtId","monthlyAmount","periodStartDate","periodEndDate",
              "createdAt","updatedAt")
           VALUES (?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6,?6)
           ON CONFLICT ("debtId","periodStartDate") DO UPDATE SET
             "monthlyAmount" = ?3, "periodEndDate" = ?5, "updatedAt" = ?6
